scope.statement: Read-only audit of raster files proven live by scripts/games/dolls.gd and its inherited OperaNurseryCatch/OperaWorldBackdrop2D path.
scope.protected_assets: The selected catcher uses m.skin_sprite_path(); its resolved approved character file depends on save state and was neither resolved nor altered here.

owners.role: builds the bounded 1024x608 Dolls layer, loads inherited baby paths, selects nursery backdrop, mounts dynamic catcher skin, and draws code-native mat/cradle/progress
loads world_nursery 2x2 tiles and crops the authored 16:9 playfield from padded POT tiles

live_raster_roles: Three BABY_PATHS textures are loaded directly by DollsNurserySurface.
world_backdrop.setup("nursery") resolves the four world_nursery tiles.
m.skin_sprite_path() resolves a protected approved Roshan skin only at runtime.
not_live_on_dolls_override: assets/opera/worlds/widgets/widget_catch_nursery.png is audit-only retired_backdrop_path and is not painted.
widget_catch_nursery_cradle.png and widget_catch_nursery_pillows.png are nulled by DollsNurserySurface after inherited setup; the live cradle and safety mat are Canvas drawing.

reviewed_assets.basis: Immediately readable swaddled baby, calm face, layered cloth bands, clean isolated silhouette, and restrained aqua palette. The narrow occupied width is intentional subject shape, not demonstrated runtime undersizing.
Clear face and swaddle silhouette, softly painted folds, clean alpha contour, and controlled coral differentiation without changing the shared form language.
Same readable swaddled-baby grammar and finish as the other variants, with coherent lavender material bands and no visible contour break in the inspected source.

reviewed_assets.role: four POT carrier tiles for the approved nursery world painting
reviewed_assets.basis: The authored regions show a distinctive moon-shell nursery, beds, mobiles, pearl lamps, coral, and a broad pale floor with polished storybook material rendering. Large flat/padded carrier regions are expected from the documented crop pipeline and are not themselves visible-scene defects. Opaque tile seams and the final crop cannot be scored from separate carrier views; contour_edges is not applicable to this opaque background group.
reviewed_assets.provenance: ASSET_LICENSES.md identifies these as project-authored runtime derivative/composite tiles from project-owned Opera art; audit/interactive_background_ownership_2026-08-29.json binds their hashes and records owner review pending.

strong_assets_to_reuse_unchanged: All three baby cutouts are suitable direct reuse at source level.
The nursery tile family has strong identity and finish and should remain the backdrop source while mounted seams/crop are checked.
unassessed_integration_gaps: The exact m.skin_sprite_path() result and its relationship to the code-native sling cannot be audited without a state-bound runtime capture.
The code-native safety mat, sling, progress pips, focus arcs, and landing halo have no standalone raster pixels to score; their quality depends on mounted composition.

Three near-identical baby silhouettes improve recognition but may reduce state differentiation when several overlap; only a live multi-faller/settled capture can establish whether color alone is sufficient.
Separate tile inspection cannot establish seam freedom, correct source-region assembly, or whether the detailed background competes with falling babies at gameplay scale.
source_findings.replacement_decision: No reviewed live raster is proven below 4.5 from source pixels. Do not regenerate or replace these files from this audit. Resolve integration evidence first.

required_runtime_capture_packet.must_show: full 1280x720 Mobile frame, resolved selected skin, empty sling, mat, pips, pointer/focus, and complete assembled nursery backdrop
at least two babies at different heights/lanes, source variants identifiable against the detailed backdrop
finger held during an interpolated drag, live sling position, lowest baby approach, and unobscured selected catcher
baby visibly seated in sling plus progress change, with layer/contact and scale readable
baby on safety mat with landing halo, proving the no-fail state is visually distinct from a catch
all three settled baby slots and filled pips before the surface closes or advances
